title: Greaves Cotton Limited (GREAVESCOT): Business, Valuation and Portfolio Action
archetype: Diversified engine maker with a loss-making electric-vehicle subsidiary (cyclical-conditional turnaround)
sector: Producer Manufacturing / Trucks, Construction and Farm Machinery
primer: Greaves Cotton makes engines, gensets and vehicle control cables, and owns 62.5% of Greaves Electric Mobility (Ampere scooters), which still loses money. The core earns 12-14% EBITDA margins and is growing 20%, but group operating cash flow was negative ₹212 crore in the first half of FY27. New capital waits for support at ₹205.02–₹211.26 with a ₹197.60 stop; our probability-weighted two-year value is about ₹289 against a base case of ₹303. You do not hold the stock, so there is nothing to sell. Cash stays at 100% until the price returns to the zone, and the call is wrong if core margins slip below 12% again or GEML needs fresh funding.
entry_posture: Consumer screen reads BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO (8.57% above the 10-week EMA, inside the 10% cap); our timing call overrides it: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, because the stock rose 11% in a week and group cash flow is unproven

ch4.stage_explanation: The market-facts ledger and the TradingView snapshot both classify GREAVESCOT as Stage 2: price above a rising 50-day and 200-day average and above the 30-week average. TheWrap's Stage 2 dashboard (dated 8 November 2026) does not list the stock, so no independent leadership confirmation exists, and the options module labels the setup STAGE2_EXTENDED.
ch4.evaluation_stage_explanation: Ledger: Stage 2 (Markup). Snapshot: Stage 2, 8.6% above the 10-week EMA, inside the 10% no-FOMO cap. TheWrap does not list the name.
ch4.posture_override: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT_PULLBACK (our timing call; the consumer screen says BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO)
ch4.posture_explanation: The consumer snapshot's near-average timing signal does not override our verdict. After an 11% one-week rise and with group cash flow unproven, we wait for the support zone.
ch4.tech_table_takeaway: The ledger values are as of the 12 November bar and the TradingView values are as of the 13 November close; small differences in close, averages and RSI are timing differences, not errors. The 52-week range is ₹119.99–₹271.90.
ch4.support_zone_explanation: Band around the rising 10-week EMA (₹208.14) and the 50-day average (₹204.14); the 30-week average (₹202.50) is the deeper shelf. The full band is below the ₹225.97 close.
ch4.stop_placement_explanation: Below the 30-week average and the support band, about 1.1 ATR beneath the 10-week EMA; gaps can cause a larger realised loss.

valuation_assessment.posture: Stretched on trailing P/E; fair only on our recovery case
valuation_assessment.note: Our own read from Chapter 7: trailing P/E of 58-67x is above engine peers on a lower ROE, the price needs about 12.5% revenue growth a year for ten years at a 12% group margin, and the probability-weighted value is about 13% a year from the close. This overrides the generic screen label 'Reasonable / In-line'.

verdict_rule_summary: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT means the business is investable but not at today's price: the probability-weighted two-year return from ₹225.97 is about 13% a year, barely above a 12% hurdle, while from the ₹205.02–₹211.26 support zone it is about 18% a year with 6.7:1 reward to risk. A COMPOUNDER_PASS business with a clear tape would earn IMMEDIATE_BUY; Greaves is CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL, so it waits.
